errors.evidence: The description incorrectly labels the axis gridline. The gridline corresponds to the value '70000' on the y-axis, whose unit is 'Хиляди лева' (Thousands of leva). The phrase 'линията за 70000 хиляди лева' (the line for 70000 thousand leva) incorrectly incorporates the axis unit into the label for the gridline itself, which is redundant and confusing. The correct way to describe it would be 'линията за 70000' (the line for 70000).
